resources.string: Open Voyah Controls is paused for safety. It restores itself after the next system restart.
Starts the car agents again after a safety stop, without the PC, while the installed files are still the approved ones.

Open Voyah Controls checks that the app, the agents and the runtime are exactly the ones approved at installation, then turns the car agents back on. Nothing is installed or changed. If a factory screen may still show changes from the stopped agents, you are asked to restart the system first.
The car agents are on again. They are ready in about half a minute.
Nothing was blocked. The car agents were started again if they had stopped.
A factory screen may still show changes from the stopped agents. Restart the system in Park: after the boot Open Voyah Controls restores itself.
The head unit is still starting. Try again in a minute.
The installed app, agents or runtime are no longer the approved ones (%s). Connect the PC and run Prepare and install in the Windows installer.
